def color_is_red(color):
    """Return True for the usual red font colors used by Excel rich text."""
    if color is None:
        return False

            return rgb.endswith("FF0000") or rgb in {"FFFF0000", "00FF0000", "FF0000"}

# Extract the manually highlighted sample fragments from the existing rich text in BD.
patterns = []
for row in range(start_row, min(end_row, ws.max_row) + 1):

                pass

    if p and p.strip():

# If the workbook was not read as rich text by the installed openpyxl build, fall back to a

    clean_patterns = [
        "Led", "jumped well", "urged", "dominant win",
        "jumped beautifuly", "kikd", "too good",
        "Slw", "imp wd", "game finish",
        "imp", "closer cn", "strong finish",
        "loomed wd cn", "fght", "tried hard",
    ]

# Sort by length descending; this prevents a short item from splitting a longer one.
clean_patterns = sorted(clean_patterns, key=«redacted» x: (-len(x), x.lower()))

# bounded so it won't be found inside a longer word/number (e.g. "too" in "took").
def build_regex(patterns):
    pieces = []
    for p in patterns:
        esc = re.escape(p)
        # If a pattern starts/ends with an alphanumeric character, require a non-word boundary
        # outside it.  This still allows punctuation/spaces around the match.
        left = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_]", p) else ""
        right = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.search(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]$", p) else ""
        pieces.append(left + esc + right)
    if not pieces:

    return re.compile("|".join(pieces), re.IGNORECASE)

base_font = InlineFont(rFont="Calibri", sz=11)

    if not text or regex is None:

    nonoverlap = []

for p in patterns:
    p = str(p)
    key = «redacted»    if p.strip() and key not in seen:

        unique_patterns.append(p)
unique_patterns.sort(key=«redacted» s: (-len(s), s.lower()))

# Whole-word / whole-number matching: a pattern beginning/ending with an alphanumeric
# character must be bounded by non-alphanumeric characters, so "too" does not match "took".
regex_parts = []
for p in unique_patterns:
    left = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_]", p) else ""
    right = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.search(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]$", p) else ""

matcher = re.compile("|".join(regex_parts), re.IGNORECASE) if regex_parts else None

normal_font = InlineFont(rFont="Calibri", sz=11)
